title: MetaphIR: Corpus-Scale Applicability Analysis for LLVM Peephole Optimizations
abstract: arXiv:2611.23555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Peephole optimizations replace short source instruction sequences with more efficient equivalents, typically guarded by preconditions such as requiring a constant operand to be a power of two. Since every new rewrite adds maintenance burden and compile-time cost, compiler developers need to know how often real-world programs both match the source pattern and satisfy its preconditions before committing to an implementation. Existing workflows fall short: structural search over an intermediate representation (IR) corpus of 4.8 million functions ignores preconditions and therefore overcounts, whereas implementing the rewrite and recompiling the corpus yields exact counts only after paying the engineering cost, with each run of the corpus's on-demand recompilation pipeline taking a median of 47 minutes. translated_title: MetaphIR：面向LLVM窥孔优化的语料库规模适用性分析
translated_abstract: 窥孔优化将较短的源指令序列替换为更高效的等价序列，通常受前置条件约束，例如要求常量操作数必须是2的幂。由于每新增一条重写规则都会增加维护负担和编译时间成本，编译器开发者在决定实现某条优化之前，需要了解真实程序同时匹配源模式并满足其前置条件的频率。现有工作流程存在不足：对包含480万个函数的中间表示（IR）语料库进行结构化搜索会忽略前置条件，因而导致计数偏高；而实现重写并重新编译整个语料库虽能得到精确计数，但需要先付出工程实现成本，且该语料库的按需重编译流水线每次运行的中位数耗时达47分钟。当需要泛化一条重写规则时，这种延迟尤其成为瓶颈，因为开发者往往需要迭代多个变体以权衡覆盖率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MetaphIR，可在LLVM IR语料库规模上同时评估窥孔优化重写规则的模式匹配与前置条件满足情况，相比忽略前置条件的结构化搜索计数更精确，且避免了完整重编译流程高昂的工程成本与47分钟级的单次运行耗时。
en_tdlr: MetaphIR enables corpus-scale applicability analysis of LLVM peephole optimizations by checking both pattern matches and their preconditions, avoiding the overcounting of structural search and the costly recompilation pipeline that takes a median of 47 minutes per run.
